item.title: Heart & Mind Equine Rescue: Self-Compassion with Horses — Sat Sep 26, 9:00 AM — Heart and Mind Equine
item.description:
Offered by Heart & Mind Equine Rescue. Meet our rescued therapy horses, explore our volunteer program, and learn about holistic horse keeping and equine-assisted services \(e.g., therapy, coaching, leadership, and team building with horses\). No experience is necessary. All are welcome, including both horse and mental health professionals.
What would it feel like to offer yourself the same kindness and care you so freely give to others?
Join Alane Freund and the Heart & Mind Equine herd for Self-Compassion with Horses, a 90-minute experiential session designed to help you slow down, become present, and reconnect with yourself.
Through mindfulness, reflection, and guided experiences with the horses, we’ll explore self-compassion, self-awareness, grounding, and authentic connection.
Horses naturally invite us into the present moment. Their sensitivity and responsiveness can help us notice what we’re feeling, soften self-criticism, and practice meeting ourselves with greater kindness

item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Sep 27, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
Source: North Bay Bohemian
